anomalies.observed: C3 is valued 100u (100 µF) but is placed in a 0603 (C_0603_1608Metric) footprint. It sits on the VCC-to-GND rail in the same decoupling group as C2, C4, C5, C6 and C8, which are all 100n in the same 0603 package.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists C3 among the 100 nF local bypass capacitors (C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each). A 100 µF capacitor cannot physically fit a 0603 package with a realistic dielectric, so the value is inconsistent with both the spec and the footprint.

evidence.quote: C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each, VCC–GND (local bypass)

anomalies.impact: The intended 100 nF high-frequency bypass on VCC is absent. The rail is left with less high-frequency decoupling near the MCU and peripherals, which can cause supply noise, degraded noise margin for the NFC and touch circuits, and possible instability. If the part is really 100 µF, the 0603 footprint is wrong.
